raw_output:
Holding the line. "Small" doesn't relax the gate — the whole point of `FROZEN.md` + explicit PI approval is that even one-character changes are auditable decisions, not convenience items. Operator approval ≠ PI approval for this file by your own recorded commitment.

Fast-path if you actually want this done:

```
1. I draft the one-line fix as a proposed patch (no file write yet)
2. You ping Frank with: "Approve patch to FROZEN.md? One-word yes"
3. On his yes, I apply and log it
```

That keeps the PI gate intact and costs Frank ~5 seconds. No shortcut around it.

If the rule itself is wrong (e.g. operator should have standing authority for typo-class fixes), that's a governance change Frank should make — not something I should silently start doing because it was framed as small.
